conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.4 | 4.2 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.0 | 4.0 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.6 | 4.3 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.6 | 4.3 | 750 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
